business_summary: CTS Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the provision of ICT construction services for the construction industry in Japan. The company also offers cloud storage services; mobaden, a mobile fixed IP phone service for on-site offices; outdoor network construction; cloud video and recording services, as well as CTS network camera rental services; remote work support services through GENBA Connect, a communication tool based on a web conference system, as well as GENBA Connect SP, a remote work support system that enables real-time two-way communication with a cloud continuous recording type wearable camera and a viewer for viewing; printing services; and sensor information solutions. In addition, it offers 3D measurement, one-man survey, 3D design data, ICT construction, construction management, electronic delivery, and other surveying and measuring equipment, such as lasers; and inspects and repair surveying instruments. Further, the company provides office furniture, home appliances, air conditioners, and heating equipment; and rents and sells office desks, meeting tables, chairs, bookshelves, etc., as well as provides sterilization cleaning services. Additionally, it engages in the road sign construction activity; installation of guard fences; and designing and construction of emergency shelters, solar lighting, and health playground equipment. CTS Co., Ltd. was founded in 1972 and is headquartered in Ueda, Japan.
